headline: Shnuggle's baby bath and changing mat lead the range, but ads are leaking into other bath products and the brand search shows rival products in five of the first 13 slots.

points.title: Baby bath, rinse cup and Ellie storage: cut ads on other bath products
points.detail: The bath range shows sponsored on searches for different products: foldable, collapsible and inflatable baths, bath chairs and cushions, Aveeno shampoo, and "bath water storage bag" (8,600 a month) on the Ellie toy scoop. Negatives free budget for the searches below.
evidence: Baby bath B084PP9W5F sponsored on: foldable baby bath (3,089/mo), baby bath chair (1,898), collapsible baby bath (1,638), baby bath cushion (1,406), inflatable baby bath (864) (Jungle Scout)
Rinse cup B0C9R3Z3YJ sponsored on: baby bath support (3,855), aveeno baby shampoo (1,138), aveeno baby wash (983)
Ellie B0C5RHGNTS sponsored on: bath water storage bag (8,595/mo)
Nappy bin B0GMQVL2SD sponsored on: snuggle ups (3,689/mo)

points.title: Baby bath: add a brand-made video and shorten the bullets
points.detail: The baby bath (~£56,000 a month, 4.7★ from 3,675 reviews) has 7 videos, all from influencers or customers, none made by Shnuggle, and 2 bullets over 250 characters that collapse on a phone. A short brand video showing the bum bump and backrest would lift conversion.
evidence: B084PP9W5F: 7 videos, all influencer or customer (Keepa)

points.title: Squishy changing mat: push "baby mat", "changing table" and "anti roll changing mat"
points.detail: The changing mat (~£58,000 a month) already ranks #5 for "changing mat", but "baby mat" (8,800 a month, #15), "anti roll changing mat" (#14) and "changing table" (7,900, #28) have no ads near the top.
evidence: baby mat: 8,756 searches/mo, organic #15, no sponsored rank
changing table: 7,933/mo, organic #28; baby changing table: 7,367/mo, #28

points.title: Brand search: show the rest of the range in the slots rivals are taking
points.detail: Shnuggle is #1 on its own name, but rival products (swaddle sacks, a nappy bin set, sleeping bags) take sponsored slots 4, 5, 11, 12 and 13 on "shnuggle", and a foldable bath takes slot 12 on "shnuggle baby bath". A brand headline ad showing the nappy bin, mat and bath keeps those shoppers in the range.
evidence: shnuggle: Cozyganoosh #4, Transitional Swaddle #5, 6-Way Omni Swaddle #11, Transitional Swaddle #12, Twist & Click nappy bin set #13 (DataForSEO)
shnuggle baby bath: SUPERBE BEBE foldable bath #12

hero_actions.B0CDLW5K89: Push baby mat, changing table and anti roll changing mat.
hero_actions.B084PP9W5F: Add a brand video, shorten bullets, negate foldable and inflatable bath searches.
hero_actions.B0GMQVL2SD: Negate nappy bag and Snuggle Ups searches.
hero_actions.B0C9R3Z3YJ: Negate Aveeno and bath support searches.
hero_actions.B0C5RHGNTS: Negate bath water storage bag; push "bath storage" (#29).

content_note: Most best-sellers score 88–100 on mobile. The baby bath is the exception: no brand video and long bullets.
ad_strategy_summary: Ads show on 8 of the top 30 searches. Prune drift into other bath products, push the mid-page changing mat and bath searches, and use a brand headline ad on "shnuggle". Indicative ~£1,500/mo on the gaps.
amc_hypotheses: Baby products are bought in a sequence (bath, mat, nappy bin, toddler bath); AMC would show how often a first purchase leads to a second Shnuggle product.
amc_questions: Which product do new customers buy first?
How many go on to buy the toddler bath?
What share of ad-driven sales are new to Shnuggle?
